slides.main:
Racism built
the biggest dance floor in Europe.
slides.sub: Notting Hill Carnival — the other origin of UK rave.
White nationalist mobs attacked Caribbean immigrants on the street.
January 1959. London's first Caribbean carnival. BBC broadcast it live.

text: A street party for the neighborhood kids.
A steel band walked. A carnival was born.
slides.sub: The first Notting Hill Carnival. The streets became the stage.

text: Duke Vin brought the sound system.
Bass you felt in your chest.
slides.sub: Dub and reggae took root in London's streets.
Two systems clash — who moves the crowd deeper. Dub plates. The war of frequencies.
Every genre stands on the sound of this street.

slides.strobe: The roots go deeper than any genre.
slides.cta: Save this. Next time you hear a bassline, trace it back.
